content.value: Being a planner you planned to make a straight elevated express way connecting Mongla (25°35'N, 89° 5'E) and Banglabandha $( 2 2 ^ { \circ }$ 25'N, 89º 25'E). If the average speed of a train on that route be 120 kmph then how much time will be required to travel from Mongla to Banglabandha?
